build.compiler_version:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.4.4.1)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

dataset.encoding: strict ASCII128, one byte per token

limitations: Development study with fixed recipes and cohort, not final-test or significance evidence.
All arms are evaluated on windows40..55; earlier cohorts are not paired controls.
Only six cells train anew; six controls re-evaluate actual historical checkpoints.
Each final trained checkpoint saw the same131072 pairs, not twelve times as much distinct data.
Initial no-update controls have no fitted-baseline comparison.
LUT-normalized NLL is not conventional softmax perplexity or the exact surrogate derivative.
Validation native predictions/gradients are recomputed; route arrays have saved digests.
Training arrays are hash/coverage verified, not replayed through every native update.
The audit shares the frozen host observer; it is not an outside-group reproduction.
No new FPGA, speed, power, energy or cost-to-quality result follows.
Binary inputs remain local and ignored; this JSON is not a full checkpoint bundle.

recipe.baseline: alpha=1,128 symbols; target counts and within-window token-target pairs only
recipe.checkpoint_256_policy: different training shifts are not expected to reproduce trained control weights
recipe.control_policy: immutable prior0/256/1024 weights, no retraining, fresh CSIM process per checkpoint

head_initialization.anchors: same original distinct anchored head; training and evaluation zshift=4
head_initialization.anchors_fine: same original distinct anchored head; training and evaluation zshift=0
head_initialization.anchors_shift1: same original distinct anchored head; training and evaluation zshift=1
head_initialization.anchors_shift2: same original distinct anchored head; training and evaluation zshift=2

recipe.initialization_policy: new training starts from anchored initial weights, byte-matched to completed controls
recipe.mechanism_evaluation: final validation, separately for every seed
recipe.projection_initialization: unchanged original LCG jitter for every cell
recipe.scope: six new training cells plus six immutable control cells; all twelve must finish before unchanged gates; no cloud, final test, adaptive extension, geometry change or hardware/speed claim
recipe.training_budget_fields: steps/training_pairs describe checkpoint training history; training_updates_performed distinguishes1024 new updates from0 control updates
recipe.validation_cohort: new fixed development windows40..55; original control cohort scores are not substituted
